rules: Every row requires the declared Talent learned level and all original learning Requirements; metadata is not permission to bypass them.
All Interrupt Conditions must hold; a missing target SkillLevel condition never becomes a global modifier.
A null delta means the source attribute is absent, not an invented zero cost or recovery.
Percent deltas are independent raw fields and must not be passed as absolute SP/MP deltas.
No stacking, percentage base, truncation, minimum cost or event timing formula is inferred.
simpleExactTargetCandidate only classifies source shape; it does not assert native consumer closure.
